title: What's New: User Experience Enhancements (2025 release wave 2)

features.name: Factbox resize behavior
features.description: The user interface now automatically adjusts when opening and closing the factbox by default. Users can also manually resize the factbox along with the copilot pane, help pane, and page scripting pane.

features.name: Advanced Tellme
features.description: A new semantic search feature that helps users find pages and reports faster by understanding the meaning of search terms rather than just matching keywords.
features.status_evidence_quote: This feature is in preview. So you need to enable that in feature management.
caveats: Must be enabled in feature management

features.name: Agent assistant instructions
features.description: Users can now provide additional instructions to agents like the sales order agent either by selecting predefined options or entering custom text instructions to help the agent complete tasks.

features.name: Week numbers in date picker
features.description: Date pickers now have an option to display week numbers on the side. Users can toggle this view by pressing Shift+Home, and the display follows regional settings.

features.name: Data masking for sensitive fields
features.description: A new property allows hiding sensitive information like bank account numbers on screen until revealed by the user. AL developers can use this property to decorate fields that contain sensitive data.
